description: A Turkish payment service provider operating as an obliged entity, storing card and KYC data in PostgreSQL. Example profile; obligations are DECLARED, not inferred.
assumptions: The entity has declared it is a MASAK-obliged payment institution (not merely 'has Turkish users').
Card data is handled; FCS-PAN-001, FCS-SAD-001 apply.
Retention is modeled per data_category; no single national delete period is assumed.
